forwardMigrationLedgerStrategy.adoptionPointRule: Do not manufacture historical provenance. Adopt a forward-only ledger only after an explicitly authorized operation proves the accepted production schema against this capture and resolves/accepts all definition drift.
steps: Freeze a reviewed schema-only production capture and its repository SHA.
Resolve or explicitly accept each DEFINITION_DRIFT and LIVE_ONLY object; do not infer that historical migration files ran merely because similar objects exist.

Choose a single adoption cutover in a dedicated follow-up: archive pre-adoption executable history out of the active forward chain or otherwise prevent it from being replayed, and create a reviewed adoption snapshot/anchor representing the accepted production state.
In a separately authorized production maintenance operation, initialize/repair the Supabase migration ledger for the approved adoption anchor without executing historical DDL.
Require every migration after the adoption point to be versioned, locally disposable-tested, reviewed, and applied through the migration workflow only.
Before any future ledger mutation, rerun the read-only provenance capture and fail closed on unexpected drift.
explicitlyForbidden: Do not run the historical migration chain against production.
Do not mark all historical migrations as applied simply to make tooling green.
Do not mutate supabase_migrations.schema_migrations during VEN-003.
Do not treat object-name similarity as proof of historical application.
